Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Copper accounts for the largest increase in your cost explanation; it sounds like protecting your margin against input-cost movements is your main concern. We want a fair adjustment that recognises your cost exposure and supports our longstanding partnership. How can we reconcile the verified index movements with the reference periods behind your calculation to establish a stable pricing basis?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €372.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains.
We have incorporated the verified decrease in the PPI-C241 index and your increased volume forecast into our revised calculation.
However, extending the payment term to 90 days would introduce financing costs that negate these cost reductions.
By maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms, we are able to offer a reduced price of €368.42 per unit.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You have recognised cost reductions but linked the lower price to faster payment—it sounds like financing exposure is a key concern. We want a stable, cost-grounded agreement that respects your cash flow without asking you to disclose your calculation. How can we reflect the verified recent copper movement in the price while recognising the financing cost you have identified?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Copper notation for cables and motors (derived) changed -2.2% from 2026-01 to 2026-03 (idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-01, idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-03).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
